title: Herbarium
description: Experience the Survival Nature of Minecraft with Stunning Visuals and Technical Utilities
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4cf37fccebe0865f83f6170d6358eec2a865ed7a_0.webp)

**Herbarium** builds upon the foundation of Vexillum, expanding its clean and performance-focused approach into a more **versatile survival experience**. While **maintaining** the same **optimized core**, this pack introduces carefully selected **technical and visual enhancements** to enrich gameplay without compromising performance.

Designed for players who want both **smooth performance** and **practical tools**, Herbarium keeps everything that makes Vexillum fast and reliable—while adding new layers of utility and atmosphere.

⸻

## ✦ Why choose Herbarium?

**⚡ Performance at its core**

Built on the same optimized foundation as Vexillum, this pack includes proven performance mods like Sodium, Lithium, and FerriteCore. The result is high FPS, reduced stuttering, and consistently smooth gameplay in both singleplayer and multiplayer.

**🧰 Technical tools for advanced gameplay**

Enhance your building and planning workflow with Litematica, allowing you to create, import, and build complex structures with precision. Additional utility-focused features make Herbarium ideal for technical players and large-scale survival projects.

**🌍 Smooth and responsive world interaction**

Just like Vexillum, improvements to chunk loading, networking, and client responsiveness ensure a seamless experience. Whether you’re exploring new terrain or working on large builds, the game remains stable and fluid.

**🎨 Enhanced visuals without compromise**

Experience a more immersive world with visual upgrades like Particle Rain and Voxy. From atmospheric weather effects to improved rendering, Herbarium delivers a noticeably more polished look while staying lightweight.

**🛠️ Balanced and purposeful**

Every addition serves a clear role—either improving usability, enhancing visuals, or supporting technical gameplay. The pack avoids unnecessary clutter while still offering more depth than a pure performance setup.

**🧱 Familiar, but expanded**

If you enjoyed Vexillum, Herbarium is the natural next step: the same clean performance philosophy, now combined with tools and visuals that make survival gameplay more engaging and rewarding.

⸻

A lightweight performance pack at heart—now with the tools and atmosphere to fully support your survival world.
